description: Ambush predator - burst poison damage from stealth. Cat-equivalent spec; Spider Form is this spec's shapeshift, trading Mana for Energy.
_source_note: Rebuilt from CoA Build Hub screenshots (Sept 2026): 14 confirmed Stalking nodes trimmed to a lean 12-node tree. Brood Marks confirmed via tooltip as the proc-and-consume identity: 'Your Venom Fang now applies a Brood Mark, stacking 5 times. Some abilities will consume them for an additional effect.' Acidfang confirmed as capstone: 'Periodic damage dealt now has a 40% chance, and critical strikes 100% chance, to grant a stack of Acidfang... next Rotfang, Withering Venom, or Facemelter within 15 seconds has -1% reduced duration and ticks -2% faster, stacking 10 times.'

Inject venom into an enemy that rots them from the inside out, dealing Plague damage over 24 sec. Damage dealt pierces resistances.' Full per-Mark table: 1 Mark 320, 2:410, 3:525, 4:666, 5:896.
